notes: The licence names no author ("the creator of the itch.io page"): SageGlint is taken from the folder name the owner uploaded it under. No source URL was uploaded with the pack.
The three fish arrive still (no skeleton, no clips): the swimRig pack step gives each a spine and two clips made in the pipeline, idle and swim.
Each model carries its own black outline shell (a mesh named Outline, for engines without outlines): it is dropped, because Oomba3D draws its own ink.

If this repository ever becomes public, the raw files of this pack (branch asset-packs) must be removed first, and the built models in public/vendor/themes/ and the pictures in public/vendor/art2d/ reviewed: the licence forbids redistributing the files as assets.
